acceptanceCriteria.statement: The productized conic module reproduces the lab reference: points on a ring's circle evaluate to ~zero Sampson distance for known camera poses; the front-branch guard rejects the behind-camera branch; the exact-in-plane degenerate case (|camY| < 1e-3) stays finite and stable (no NaN, no sign flap) despite the double-line conic's ~2x distance error.

verifyVia.input: Headless unit suite over ported lab poses (mid-range in-plane, grazing, gentle, overview) plus the |camY| < 1e-3 degenerate cell.
verifyVia.observable: All assertions pass: on-circle Sampson ~0, off-circle monotone growth, behind-camera fragments rejected, degenerate cell finite/stable across a 90-step camY sweep.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The mid-range near-plane dead zone is gone: at the dig's dead-zone poses (pitch 0.002-0.05 at [3000,0,0] dist 25) where shipped SDF paints ZERO pixels, the conic pass paints the LineLoop class of pixels — wherever the old LineLoop drew a solid line, the ring renders.

verifyVia.input: Drive the lab dead-zone pose battery (poseCamera + measure) in conic mode with prox fade neutralized; compare against the LineLoop baseline column.
verifyVia.observable: Zero-pixel rows eliminated; painted px within the LineLoop class at every dead-zone pose (dig reference: 1314 px identical at pitch .01).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Max's round-3 finding — 'flickering on far-away orbits when we are close to the orbit's plane' — is gone: camera drift near the plane no longer toggles ring pixels at the dead-zone boundary.

verifyVia.input: driftMeasure 90-frame camera drift at the dead-zone boundary pose and the grazing @5200 pose, conic mode.
verifyVia.observable: Mid-range drift toggles/frame ~0 (dig: 0 vs LineLoop 0.8 vs shipped invisible); grazing toggle-per-green at the LineLoop floor class (<=~0.125 vs shipped 0.184).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Standing at or near a ring with prox fade off shows a clean stable solid line — the shipped tearing/blotch structure is gone. Prox fade itself stays as shipped UX on top.

verifyVia.input: Near-field pose (standing on the ring), setProxFade({off:true}), conic mode; then fade re-enabled.
verifyVia.observable: Contiguous stable band under drift (evidence class: dig-nearfield-conic.png vs dig-nearfield-sdf-fadeoff.png); with fade re-enabled the shipped fade envelope applies unchanged.
